data.title: Restore a file from backup
data.summary: Recover one missing file without replacing the working copy.
data.body:
# Why

A separate restored copy lets you check the file before replacing anything.

## You need

- Access to an approved backup
- A separate folder for the restored copy

## Steps

1. Open the backup tool and find the missing file.
2. Choose a copy made before the file went missing.
3. Restore it to a separate folder.
4. Open the restored file and check its contents.

## Done when

The restored file opens and contains the version you need.

## If it fails

Read [If the backup server is down](/backups/backup-server-down/).

## Related

- [Backup terms](/reference/backup-terms/)
- [Read the guide](/start/read-this-guide/)

Last verified by the guide editor on October 10, 2026.

data.title: If the backup server is down
data.summary: The backup tool cannot reach the place where copies are kept.
data.body:
# You will see

The backup tool says it cannot connect.

## Check first

1. Check that your connection works.
2. Read the backup tool’s status message.

## Fix

1. Wait briefly, then try once more.
2. Ask the backup maintainer if the same message returns.

## Who to ask

Ask the person responsible for the backup service.

## Do not

Do not delete the working file or reset the backup while checking a connection problem.

## Related

- [Restore a file](/backups/restore-a-file/)

Last verified by the guide editor on October 10, 2026.

data.title: Backup terms
data.summary: A small reference for reading the backup guides.
data.body:
# Why

Use the same words when asking for help.

```text
Term       Meaning
Backup     A separate copy kept for recovery
Restore    Bring a saved copy back
Verify     Check that the saved copy opens
```
